correctness.rationale: The exact lift formula counts every coefficient triple once because \(C=A+uB\) and the canonical two-coin parametrization is unique. It yields exact first thresholds for \(0\le p\le\lfloor A/u\rfloor+1\); the unique maximizing residue and parity-dependent first break follow from \(uB>A\). Boundary cases \(p=0\), \(i=2\), and \(A\bmod u\in\{0,1\}\) were verified separately. The bundled finite checker independently tests 20 parameter cases and 12,341 residue thresholds.

value.rationale: The natural \(p\)-Frobenius invariant for three consecutive Pell-type recurrence terms is determined over an entire parameter-dependent initial phase, its first sharp parity-dependent failure is located, and all residue first-crossing thresholds are classified. This fills a motivated representation-multiplicity gap beyond ordinary two-coin membership rather than an isolated numerical example.
